---
name: Non-sensitive bug
about: Report a reproducible ordinary bug without private or security-sensitive data
title: ''
---

Use the affected repository's verified private reporting route for a suspected
vulnerability. Do not include confidential details in this public form.

## Source and environment

Identify the repository, exact source/version and relevant platform using
nonidentifying values. Use placeholders for configuration and endpoints.

## Minimal synthetic reproduction

Describe steps and owned test inputs that reproduce the ordinary bug.

## Expected and observed behavior

State the concrete difference and any known scope limits.

## Evidence already checked

List actual checks and outcomes, with skips or incomplete work explicit.
Use sanitized English summaries; omit personal paths, identities, credentials,
account/wallet inventories, signing material and raw private diagnostics.
